name: fresh-change-measurements
goal: Collect source measurements from the selected commit across all entity pages, retain fresh workload observations, and require change measurements in Harness guidance.

evidence: Old prepared history contains 1244 units with no source observations and a record with no measurements. Local pages must enrich from the exact selected Git commit without rewriting stored evidence. Current source observations must outrank missing record placeholders. Changed executable units require real representative timing and memory observations with revision, workload, target and profile; no invented or borrowed values.

History indexing tests proved fresh builds but never read an older prepared revision through the local server. Formatter tests covered absent values without a current source observation and did not test its precedence. Extend these existing standard tests and the existing multi-metric browser scenario across entity kinds and viewports; preserve originals and commit attribution.

Frozen test commit e00cd6bf: red a7748fac314dfab13f9274604ae21d02aa82e1f784db20f3c7b9de1772ef1c5d reproduced missing legacy source and stale formatter precedence. Fourteen static-source assertions across seven kinds and three widths fail. Actual route controls pass and retain 42 page measurements.

Source reader enriches old prepared data from the selected immutable Git tree without editing stored proof; current source observations take precedence across every entity kind. Change-measurement policy is updated in local and generated skills plus reusable harness-project skill. Product b00cb23e passes registry validation and Reports full check.

At b00cb23e, unchanged corpus from red e00cd6bf passes: 4 history integration tests, 8 formatter tests, 3 responsive seven-kind component cases and 3 real seven-kind route cases. Green 1dc9ee1d716b3cde043f4792ce74f1a547d0b39db196f3ff6e5fb888f98bfd00 retains 46 observations: 42 page navigation/heap, 2 reader warm latency/process RSS, and 2 formatter warm latency/process RSS. Tests, fixtures, command, assertion and environment are unchanged.
